detail.body:
### What does this PR do?

Fixes two follow-up issues from #8233 in `examples/tpu/sft`:

1. **`examples/tpu/sft/run_qwen3_0_6b_torchtitan.sh`**: Because the script starts with `set -xeuo pipefail`, line 115 (`DEFAULT_MASTER_ADDR="${TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES%%,*}"`) aborts with `TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES: unbound variable` whenever `TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES` is unset (for example on single-host TPU v6e-4 VMs or single-host GKE TPU pods where the webhook does not inject `TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES`), before reaching the `127.0.0.1` fallback on line 116 (and even when `MASTER_ADDR` is explicitly provided). Default `TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES` to `127.0.0.1` before stripping `,.*`.
2. **`examples/tpu/sft/README.md`**: #8233 changed `run_qwen3_0_6b_torchtitan.sh` to default to `SFT_TRAINER_MODE=torchrun` (was `ray`), so the README's `ray job submit` commands need `SFT_TRAINER_MODE=ray` and the `verl-hardware-plugin` runtime environment (`VERL_PLATFORM=tpu`, `VERL_USE_EXTERNAL_MODULES=verl_hardware_plugin`, matching `examples/tpu/grpo/README.md`).

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+tpu+sft (no open PR modifies `examples/tpu/sft/`).
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

### Test

- Verified the single-host TPU v6e-4 `torchrun` (`MASTER_ADDR=127.0.0.1` when `TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES` is unset in the pod) and `ray` SFT smoke tests in TPU E2E CI (`e2e_sft_llm_tpu`: 8 steps, Ray `train/loss` `1.3779 -> 0.5452` / `val/loss` `0.7239 -> 0.6082`; `torchrun` `train/loss` `1.3818 -> 0.5464` / `val/loss` `0.7234 -> 0.6084`).
- Verified bash parameter expansion under `set -u`:
  ```bash
  for v in UNSET localhost h0,h1; do
    (set -u; [[ $v != UNSET ]] && export TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES=$v; D="${TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES:-127.0.0.1}"; D="${D%%,*}"; echo "$v -> ${MASTER_ADDR:-$D}")
  done
  # UNSET -> 127.0.0.1
  # localhost -> localhost
  # h0,h1 -> h0
  ```
- Ran `SKIP=autogen-trainer-cfg pre-commit run --from-ref upstream/main --to-ref HEAD` (all passed).
- AI assistance was used to draft and verify this PR.

### API and Usage Example

```bash
# Single-host TPU v6e-4 (torchrun default, works even when TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES is unset)
NNODES_TRAINER=1 N_CHIPS_TRAINER=4 DATA_PARALLEL_SHARD_SIZE=4   bash examples/tpu/sft/run_qwen3_0_6b_torchtitan.sh
```

### Design & Code Changes

- `examples/tpu/sft/run_qwen3_0_6b_torchtitan.sh`: replace `DEFAULT_MASTER_ADDR="${TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES%%,*}"` with `DEFAULT_MASTER_ADDR="${TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES:-127.0.0.1}"` followed by `DEFAULT_MASTER_ADDR="${DEFAULT_MASTER_ADDR%%,*}"`.
- `examples/tpu/sft/README.md`: update the default mode description and add `SFT_TRAINER_MODE=ray` + `RUNTIME_ENV` to the `ray job submit` examples.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`
- [x] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. If not feasible, explain why: Covered by the TPU SFT example script and TPU E2E CI (`e2e_sft_llm_tpu`).

inline_comments.body:
**🩺 Stability & Availability** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Reject the loopback fallback for multi-node runs.**

When `TPU_WORKER_HOSTNAMES` and `MASTER_ADDR` are unset, this assigns `127.0.0.1`. `NNODES_TRAINER` defaults to 2, so workers on other nodes cannot reach the master through their own loopback address, and training fails to rendezvous. Use loopback only for single-node runs. For multi-node runs, require a routable address or exit before launching `torchrun`.
